Clark Estates Inc decreased its stake in Scripps Networks Interact In (SNI) by 73.75% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 89,500 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $7.69M, down from 341,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clark Estates Inc who had been investing in Scripps Networks Interact In for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.66 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.77% or $1.56 during the last trading session, reaching $89.77. About 497,245 shares traded. Scripps Networks Interactive, Inc. (NYSE:SNI) has risen 9.83% since February 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.87% the S&P500.

The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Hold” on Wednesday, August 2. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Thursday, July 20 by Wells Fargo.
